verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. The publication predicate now requires the [package] value to be exactly the boolean token false and includes regressions for registry allow-lists, true, absence, inheritance, and declarations outside [package]. The dependency trip-wire now resolves renamed workspace-dependency aliases before scanning every other workspace crate and covers inherited, table-form, target-specific, and direct renamed dependencies, with negative controls for prefix-sharing crates and the non-edge workspace declaration itself. The current workspace member layout is entirely crates/*, matching the scan boundary. The deferral record remains explicit that this is not a threat model, documents live assurance and supply-chain exposures, and makes no unsupported safety claim.
